definitions.explanation: A period of twenty-five years. Used to emphasize the length of time, often in retrospective or milestone contexts.

examples.japanese: {四半世紀|しはんせいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
{四半世紀|しはんせいき}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: I visited my hometown for the first time in a quarter century.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四半世紀|しはんせいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦リード→リード：11601_riido⟧してきた。
examples.english: This company has led the industry for a quarter century.

notes:
Compound of {四半|しはん} (one quarter) and ⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧ (century). A somewhat formal expression used in journalism, speeches, and commemorative contexts to emphasize the significance of a 25-year span.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四半世紀|しはんせいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧ — a quarter century passes
- {四半世紀|しはんせいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって — over a quarter century
- {四半世紀|しはんせいき}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — for the first time in a quarter century
- ⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{四半世紀|しはんせいき} — approximately a quarter century

- {半世紀|はんせいき} — half a century (50 years)
- ⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧ — century (100 years)
